title: Kissed Charred Brazilian Cheese Onigiri
description: A charred and molten Brazilian dish featuring cheese and onigiri, perfect for a snack or light meal, made with warm water and shaped into nigiri
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the water and cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Allow the cooked rice to cool down to room temperature.
Mix the cooled rice with salt and vegetable oil in a large bowl.
Add the Brazilian cheese to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Wet your hands with warm water and shape the rice mixture into small triangular shapes, similar to nigiri.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of vegetable oil.
Place the shaped onigiri in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until charred and crispy.
Remove the onigiri from the skillet and serve immediately.
